CustomField.description: Frequency unit for recurring installments. Allowed values: Monthly, Weekly, Daily, Yearly, Custom. Custom disables engine fanout — no Expected GiftTransactions are auto-created; each installment must be inserted independently with GiftCommitmentId + GiftCommitmentScheduleId set. Custom requires parent GiftCommitment.ScheduleType='Custom' and this row's Type='CreateTransactions' or the insert rejects with FIELD_INTEGRITY_EXCEPTION. TransactionInterval and TransactionDay omitted at insert default to 1 post-save.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Choose 'Custom' for grants and pledges with irregular payment amounts or spacing. When 'Custom' is selected, enter each installment as its own gift transaction.
